config.cyd_creator.disabled_desc: Switch it on to design and build apps for CYD boards. Docker must be configured.
config.cyd_creator.model_help: Provider the CYD Creator agent works with. Empty uses the main LLM.
config.cyd_creator.restart_note: Switching CYD Creator on and changing the builder image, memory, CPU cores or idle stop take effect after an AuraGo restart. All other settings apply right away.
config.section.cyd_creator.desc: Builds apps for Cheap Yellow Display boards with a designer and an agent.
config.section.cyd_creator.label: CYD Creator
help.cyd_creator.builder_image: Published toolchain image. AuraGo pulls it once and never builds it locally.
help.cyd_creator.cold_build_timeout_seco: Applies while the build cache of a project and board is still empty.
help.cyd_creator.enabled: Shows the CYD Creator app on the desktop. Building needs a configured Docker host.
help.cyd_creator.max_repair_attempts: How often the agent may fix compile errors before the job fails.
help.cyd_creator.ota_enabled: Devices with the AuraGo link download new builds by themselves.
help.cyd_creator.ota_public_url: URL the devices use to reach AuraGo. Empty uses the server settings.
config.cyd_creator.memory_mb_help: Memory for the build container in megabytes (default 2048).
config.cyd_creator.cpu_cores_help: CPU cores for the build container, half values are possible (default 2).
config.cyd_creator.build_timeout_seconds: A normal build is aborted after this many seconds (default 300).
config.cyd_creator.idle_stop_minutes_hel: The build container stops after this many minutes without a job to free resources (default 20).
config.cyd_creator.keep_builds_per_proje: How many earlier builds are kept per project, older ones are deleted (default 5).
config.cyd_creator.job_timeout_minutes_h: Total time the agent may spend on one job including repair attempts (default 20 minutes).
config.cyd_creator.ota_heartbeat_seconds: Interval at which a CYD device asks the server for updates (default 60 seconds).
